title: Closed points of a scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme. A point $x\in X$ is *closed* if the one-point set $\{x\}$ is closed in the underlying topological space of $X$. Write $|X|$ for the set of closed points of $X$.

source.place: §1, (1.1), p. 273: "$|X|$ l'ensemble des points fermés de $X$" (the notation; a closed point is one whose singleton is closed)
